name: Railway Platform
description: Protects against destructive Railway CLI and Public API operations that can delete projects, environments, services, functions, volumes, variables, or deployments.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-project-delete
destructive_patterns.description: railway delete schedules deletion of the entire Railway project.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Deleting a Railway project can remove every service, database, volume, variable, and deployment attached to it.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-project-subcommand-delete
destructive_patterns.description: railway project delete schedules deletion of the entire Railway project.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Deleting a Railway project can remove every service, database, volume, variable, and deployment attached to it.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-environment-delete
destructive_patterns.description: railway environment delete removes a Railway environment and its resources.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Deleting an environment can remove production services, database instances, volumes, and variables in that environment.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-service-delete
destructive_patterns.description: railway service delete permanently deletes a Railway service.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Deleting a service can remove the production app or managed database service and its deployment history.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-function-delete
destructive_patterns.description: railway functions delete removes a Railway serverless function.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Deleting a Railway function can remove production serverless code, HTTP endpoints, or scheduled jobs.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-volume-delete
destructive_patterns.description: railway volume delete removes persistent Railway storage.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Deleting a Railway volume can destroy persistent database storage and is catastrophic when the volume backs production data.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-volume-detach
destructive_patterns.description: railway volume detach disconnects persistent storage from a service.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Detaching a volume can take a production database or stateful service offline even when the bytes are not immediately deleted.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-variable-delete
destructive_patterns.description: railway variable delete removes Railway environment variables.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Deleting environment variables can break production deploys, database connections, credentials, and service-to-service links.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-database-variable-set
destructive_patterns.description: railway variable set is changing a database connection variable.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Overwriting database connection variables can redirect production traffic or disconnect an app from its production database.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-database-variable-legacy-set
destructive_patterns.description: railway variable legacy flags are changing a database connection variable.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Legacy Railway variable flags can still overwrite database connection variables and break production database access.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-deployment-remove
destructive_patterns.description: railway down removes the latest successful deployment.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Removing a deployment can interrupt production service availability.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-project-delete
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API project deletion mutation detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Railway GraphQL project deletion mutations can remove an entire project and all attached production resources.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-environment-delete
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API environment deletion mutation detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Railway GraphQL environment deletion mutations can remove production services, databases, volumes, and variables.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-service-delete
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API service deletion mutation detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Railway GraphQL service deletion mutations can remove a production app or managed database service.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-volume-delete
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API volume deletion mutation detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Railway GraphQL volume deletion mutations can destroy persistent database storage.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-volume-backup-restore
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API volume backup restore mutation detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Restoring a Railway volume backup can replace current persistent data and roll back a production database.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-volume-backup-delete
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API volume backup deletion mutation detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Deleting Railway volume backups removes recovery points for persistent database storage.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-volume-backup-schedule-update
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API volume backup schedule update mutation detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Changing Railway volume backup schedules can disable or weaken database recovery coverage.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-volume-detach
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API volume detach mutation detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Railway GraphQL volumeInstanceUpdate with serviceId null detaches persistent storage from its service.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-variable-delete
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API variable deletion mutation detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Railway GraphQL variable deletion mutations can remove credentials or database connection variables from production environments.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-variable-collection-replace
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API variableCollectionUpsert with replace=true detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Railway variableCollectionUpsert with replace=true deletes variables omitted from the payload, which can remove production database credentials even when their names are not present.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-database-variable-upsert
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API upsert is changing a database connection variable.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Bulk-upserting Railway variables that include database connection keys can redirect or sever production database access.

destructive_patterns.name: railway-api-deployment-remove
destructive_patterns.description: Railway Public API deployment removal or stop mutation detected.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Railway GraphQL deployment removal and stop mutations can interrupt production availability.
